full_prompt_en: A square Dada-inspired collage combines a black-and-white photograph of a suited man holding a megaphone with large blocks of yellow, red, and dark blue print. The man's cropped upper body fills the left half; his face is partly hidden behind the round black mouth of the megaphone, which points toward the viewer from the upper left. His dark jacket and tie merge into scratched black ink areas below. Across the top left, a fragment of large black serif lettering is cut by the image edge and by overlapping paper, so the complete word cannot be read. On the upper right, a rough red circular form presses into a field of bright yellow, with a vertical dark blue strip dividing it from the photograph. Near the center right, a large block capital D stands over another scuffed photographic fragment. Below it, tiny print-like marks run in a short horizontal band, too small to decipher. Along the bottom, rough rectangular strips in orange-red, deep teal, black, and cream overlap the man's lower torso. A large black capital A rises near the lower center-right, partly covered by surrounding distressed textures. Small pieces of monochrome imagery and torn-looking edges interrupt the flat color fields. Paper wear, scratches, rubbed ink, and uneven registration are visible across nearly every layer. Light is graphic rather than photographic across the whole piece: the grayscale figure retains soft tonal modeling, while the colored shapes stay flat and opaque. The off-center portrait and oversized fragments jostle for attention, making the image feel deliberately assembled and unstable. The overall composition is noisy, confrontational, and rhythmic, with typographic scale and primary-color collision organizing the disorder.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形达达主义气质的拼贴，把一张穿西装男子手持扩音器的黑白照片，与大块黄、红和深蓝印刷色片组合。男子被裁切的上半身占据左半边；他面容的一部分被扩音器圆形黑口遮住，扩音器从左上朝观者指来。深色外套和领带在下方与带刮痕的黑墨区域融在一起。左上角一段大号黑色衬线字母被画边及重叠纸片裁断，因此完整词语无法辨认。右上方一片粗糙的红色圆形压在亮黄底色里，一条竖向深蓝带把它与照片分开。靠近右侧中央，一个巨大的大写字母 D 覆在另一块磨损的摄影碎片上。其下短短一条细小印字痕迹太小而无法辨认。沿底部，橘红、深青、黑与奶油色的粗糙矩形纸条覆盖男子下半身。一个巨大的黑色大写字母 A 在右下中央附近升起，局部被周围磨损纹理遮住。小块单色图像和撕裂般的边缘打断平坦色域。纸面磨耗、刮痕、擦去的油墨和不齐的套印几乎遍布每一层。整幅作品的光线是图形性的：灰阶人物保留柔软明暗塑形，彩色形状则平坦不透明。偏心的人物像与过大碎片争夺注意力，让画面显得有意拼装且不稳定。整体构图喧闹、带有对抗性又富节奏，由文字尺度和原色碰撞组织其混乱。
style_prompt_en: The image has a distressed print-collage surface made of abrupt photographic, typographic, and flat-color layers. Hard rectangular cuts meet torn-looking, scratched edges; oversized cropped marks interrupt smaller fragments and make the scale intentionally inconsistent. Black, cream, poster yellow, hot red, and deep teal-blue dominate, with grayscale tonal imagery set against opaque color blocks. Ink appears rubbed away in patches, paper carries scuffs, and slight registration shifts make the layers feel manually assembled. Illumination is mixed: photographic areas have soft internal shading, while flat printed fields remain nearly shadowless. A strong off-center focal mass is countered by large circular and letter-like forms, producing a restless push across the whole frame. The overall effect is irreverent, noisy, and tactile, with collision and interruption serving as the main visual rhythm.
style_prompt_zh: 图像具有磨损的印刷拼贴表面，由骤然相接的摄影、字体与平涂色层组成。硬直矩形切口与似被撕裂、刮擦的边缘相遇；过大且被裁切的符号打断较小碎片，使尺度有意不一致。黑、奶油白、海报黄、炽红和深青蓝占主导，灰阶明暗图像与不透明色块对照。油墨局部似被擦去，纸面留有磨痕，轻微套印错位让层次仿佛手工拼装。照明是混合的：摄影部分有柔和的内部明暗，平面印刷色域则几乎没有阴影。偏心的大块焦点由大型圆形和字形结构平衡，形成横贯全画面的不安推动。整体效果不恭、喧闹且可触，碰撞与打断是主要视觉节奏。
theme_en: A distressed collage of a man with a megaphone, cropped letters, and bold red-yellow geometry
theme_zh: 由拿扩音器的男子、裁切字母和醒目红黄色几何形组成的磨损拼贴
name: Dada movement
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
